# API-First Video App

This project is a mobile video app built with a strict API-first architecture.

React Native app acts as a thin client and depends entirely on a Flask backend.

## 🏗 Architecture

React Native → Flask API → MongoDB → YouTube (abstracted)

The frontend never receives raw YouTube URLs. Video streaming is secured using short-lived playback tokens generated by the backend.

---

## 🔐 Authentication Flow

- User signs up or logs in
- Backend returns JWT
- JWT stored securely on device using SecureStore
- All protected routes require Authorization header

---

## 🎥 Video Abstraction Strategy

The backend stores only YouTube IDs.
When a user plays a video:

1. App requests a short-lived playback token
2. App calls `/video/<id>/stream?token=...`
3. Backend validates token and returns masked YouTube embed URL

This prevents exposing raw YouTube links to the client.

---

## ⚙️ Backend Setup

```bash
cd backend
python -m venv venv
source venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
cp .env.example .env
